steps.assistant_text: IDO 7.1 NCC donor finished from the 99.964 NM donor. The residual was frame homes of arm 1's temporaries: edg's function-wide pointer temp pool slots (inline this / reference temps) are homed where each slot is first allocated, and arm 1 allocated two of them between its own temporaries. A dead if (0) { *va.me()->me() += *vb.me(); } before the arm (zero-code V3 *me() { return this; }, nested so three slots are live at once) allocates them earlier, above the arm's temporaries, giving the target's sp+156 / 172 / 184. Spliced over a placeholder on both build paths.
